caption: The drawing depicts a pair of slip-on shoes presented in two views: the top pair shows the shoes from above, side by side with the toe areas pointing downward, while the single shoe below is displayed from a side perspective. The shoes are primarily dark in color, likely black, with notable decorative embroidery on the toe sections, using red and gold thread to form ornate symmetrical patterns. The edges around the openings of the shoes are lined with a scalloped red border. The interiors of the shoes are light beige. The background of the drawing is plain and unadorned, allowing all focus to remain on the depicted footwear.
title: Woman's Slippers
